notes.title: 🐉 World Boss - Major Update
notes.notes:
Gloves on, Boxers!

It is time for the awaited major changes for Box To The Beat VR. Let's talk about the brand new world boss, arcade mode, a training dummy to continue shining with your reflexes, and more!

We're thrilled to present this information. Our biggest update yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[h3]New changes[/h3]

[h3]🐉 [u]Introducing the new World Boss[/u][/h3]

To mark the official release of Box To The Beat VR on the PSVR2, it is time to let your players meet our long-awaited [b]World Boss[/b]! A majestic dragon boosted with a large amount of HP made his way to today's main event.

Join together and defeat this magical creature to win collective rewards for everyone! It's time to prove your rhythmic skill in this battle of the century. Are you up for the challenge? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/60db18d2755c03fd79d3e71ed37733de86066cb2.png[/img]

[h3]🥊 [u]Arcade Mode[/u][/h3]

Want to try something with a bit more punch to it? The team is happy to announce the brand new mode, Arcade. 

Participating in Arcade will allow you to meet power-ups that increase the game's difficulty. At the same time, these power-ups will also offer bonuses to boost your top scores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/ca00ee60dd7348fab2169895cb1b4fcba624aab1.png[/img]

[h3]🥊 [u]New milestone: 3,000,000 punches WORLDWIDE![/u][/h3]

As mentioned in our previous announcement, it is time to reward all our players after reaching yet another important step related to our project. Jump right into our third volume and enjoy 3 new [b]FREE[/b] songs!

- "[b]Bravo Sierra[/b]" by Glories
- "[b]The Arcade[/b]" by HVRDVR
- "[b]Flight of the Bumblebee[/b]" by Ace

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/a4ef48d92e8d8eddef9d473d29be0aa7846e95d1.png[/img]

[h3]🥊 [u]Punch collisions and stricter directions[/u][/h3]

To bridge the gap between arcade mode, classic, and dynamic, we have made it so that the punch collisions in classic and dynamic are stricter. Players will not receive only one point if they hit the notes in the wrong direction but the combo will remain active.

In arcade mode, however, you must pay double attention to the punch direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/a94ea2745650eb0a14ac2c36812532c1d9f08612.png[/img]

[h3]🥊 [u]Training Dummies[/u][/h3]

Say hello to your little friends! These training dummies will match the incoming notes to assist you in reaching sky-high with multiple high scores. You are more than welcome to follow along!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/28e970c8b050874eec8f57d77bce01d229f36dec.png[/img]

[h3]🥊 [u]Fun interactions[/u][/h3]

Want to warm up before your competition? A training dummy was also added to the main menu. Feel free to have fun and throw a few punches here and there. Have you had any funny moments with this new feature? Join our socials and share them with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/1f8dfc22c71c2fba7a687deaa66440188618e770.png[/img]

[h3]🐋 [u]A message from the team[/u][/h3]

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to Box To The Beat. As always, stay light on your feet and Box To The Beat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/ef695c97ae9fed3142f97acfc431e28d3c6d06eb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

⁍ Check out Box To The Beat VR here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063120/Box_To_The_Beat_VR/

⁍ Join our Discord community here: [url=https://discord.gg/MCkKy6qgmt]Khosouf Studio[/url]

Thank you for reading our major update!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/ISTHATGABE/][i]Gabe[/i][/url]

notes.title: Box To The Beat VR coming to PSVR2 & Upcoming Major Update!
notes.notes:
Gloves on, Boxers!

[h3]🎉 PSVR2 Announcement[/h3]

The team is beyond excited to announce that Box To The Beat VR has passed PlayStation's certification to mark the FIRST game from the Middle East that will arrive on the official [b]PlayStation®VR2[/b]!!! 

After multiple attempts (24 to be more exact, haha) and six months of constant tasks to complete it, the joy of seeing the approval, together with the results, has made everything worthwhile in the end. 

[b]Coming soon, right on your friendly neighbourhood PlayStation platform.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/63f32e6ac571ec0925d5795092eabc6394c39572.png[/img]

[h3]🎉Major Update[/h3]

The momentum is not stopping here! Let's dive into a short teaser regarding our upcoming major update for [b]Box To The Beat VR[/b]! 

Get ready to continue punching, moving, and feeling the rhythm because our studio has many new features to show. Here's a quick list of some of the many new additions that will become available soon:

🥊 ⁍ 3 new free songs for Volume 3

🥊 ⁍ A new boxing dummy for you to practice on. It's also entirely reactive to the songs!

🥊 ⁍ The launch of the previously mentioned 15.000.000 HP World Boss. Work with all the players to face the majestic dragon. Dealing high damage to the boss will reward individual players with exclusive limited-time rewards.

🥊 ⁍ PSVR2 version launch.

🥊 ⁍ A big fix for accurate punches. No more uppercuts on notes from the top!

🥊 ⁍ An in-game dragon boss for all maps.
And much more!

[h3]🎉UFC Showcase[/h3]

You didn't think that's all, did you? We embark on yet another journey where Box To The Beat VR will be sent in with shock & awe. We are pushing for approval to be showcased in the upcoming UFC event on the same date as our PSVR2 launch! Fingers crossed for this one as well!

One thing is for certain: we couldn't reach these milestones without our players. Our community. Our boxers. Thank you for constantly supporting our project, and we'll see you in the following available updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

Check out Box to the Beat VR here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063120/Box_To_The_Beat_VR/

As always, keep light on your feet and Box To The Beat,
[i]Gabe[/i]

notes.title: 🥊 Patch Notes: 3.0
notes.notes:
Gloves on, Boxers!

Welcome to our official 3.0 patch notes, where we will also share some exciting news about the usage of LIV.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[h3]New changes[/h3]

🥊 [u]LIV Support[/u]

We are happy to announce that after investigation and playtesting, LIV has been restored to a working state. You can now seamlessly create content for Box To The Beat using LIV. This is an ambitious change from our side and we hope that it will connect all the boxers even more! 

Celebrate, box and feel the rhythm with yet another step towards the best Box To The Beat VR experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/a9d0a6639d858e17763648663375953dfd9bbdaa.png[/img]

🥊 [u]Added new light show environment[/u]

We've made a full overhaul for the light environment! A true champion deserves a grand entrance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/0adf8bbad3163c3e1993ab8530229820c71ca878.png[/img]

🥊 [u]Uppercuts and hook collisions[/u]

Sync flawlessly with our improved/fine-tuned collision detection. This will make your punches feel more responsive. We understand that timing is important, so the team will constantly monitor this situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/92192ee162a5b805f1514ba2141212302541ed60.png[/img]

🥊 [u]Worldwide Punch Counter[/u]

Connect with the community through a fresh world counter that shows the total number of hits placed within Box To The Beat VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/8bd610d24dc5b4d44704c37e93843b955280f7a9.png[/img]

🥊 [u]Volume 3 - LIVE[/u]

The player base hit a new milestone: Over 1 million punches in the game. With this in mind, volume 3 has been implemented, and everyone will experience one new song [b]every week[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/73d77871b39f639836b66021161b3815cef8f46a.png[/img]

🥊 [u]News Tab[/u]

Keep up to date with our latest announcements right from the game. Who knows, maybe something will show up. What about a majestic world boss? 🐉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/346128f235b31d0e03cdcad39ed074d9c6341ed7.png[/img]

🥊 [u]Bonus Score[/u]

Dynamic, fast, and beast modes will receive a 10% bonus score boost now. Push your skills to the limit and beyond.

🥊 [u]Score Multiplier Duration[/u]

Development has buffed the duration of the score multiplier so that players will have more windows of opportunity to secure their own high scores.

🥊 [u]Double upgrade for song flow[/u]

After the previous patch notes, we decided to dive into the flow once again. Expect even more enjoyment when playing your available song tracks.

[h3]Quality of life[/h3]

🛠️ Updated the score-saving system.
• In light of your feedback following our recent scoring system adjustment, we've made changes. Now, your previous high score will only be replaced if you achieve a higher rank.

Thank you for reading our update! Stay tuned for more in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

Check out Box to the Beat VR here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063120/Box_To_The_Beat_VR/

Stay light on your feet and Box To The Beat,
[i]Gabe[/i]

As always, thank you for your constant support and feedback!

notes.title: 🥊 Patch Notes: 1.0
notes.notes:
Gloves on, Boxers!

Welcome to our official 1.0 patch notes, where we will discuss all the changes that will make Box to the Beat VR's launch a better experience for all our players.

As always, thank you for your constant support and feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[h3]New changes[/h3]

🥊 [u]Updated network checker for worldwide support[/u]

The network checker received much attention to ensure more precise connectivity across the globe. Enjoy a smoother experience!

🥊 [u]HP System Rebalancing[/u]

We've fine-tuned the HP System to provide a more balanced and engaging gameplay experience, making every punch count.

🥊 [u]Punch collision detection is now more accurate[/u] 

Your punches will now be even more precise as we've refined the collision detection system, ensuring that your movements translate flawlessly in-game.

🥊 [u]Internet check is now constant and will warn you when there is no network[/u]

The constant internet check will now promptly notify you if your connection is lost during play. This way, players will not lose real-time updates while boxing to their beat.

🥊 [u]Replaced song volume option with slider[/u] 

We've revamped the audio settings, replacing the song volume option with an intuitive slider for more precise control over the music.

🥊 [u]Added options for hit volume and announcer volume[/u]

You will now be able to customize your experience through our available options. Box as loud as you wish or keep it quiet until the main event arrives!

🥊 [u]Rank system adjustments[/u]

We understand that players want to improve while playing, and mastering combos can easily add to the fun. The rank system has been fine-tuned to provide a more rewarding progression curve.

🥊 [u]Updated the "New Beginnings" trophy[/u]

The "New Beginnings" trophy will now unlock as soon as you start playing a level, marking the start of your Box to the Beat journey.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

• Fixed a bug where you could not pet your dragon in the menu
[i]Interact with your dragon companion now as we've addressed the issue that prevented this delightful interaction.[/i]

Thank you for reading our update! Stay tuned for more in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

Check out Box to the Beat VR here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063120/Box_To_The_Beat_VR/

Keep boxing to your beat,
[i]Gabe[/i]

notes.title: Meet Us At Gamescom!
notes.notes:

notes.title: 🥊 Major Update V1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/1df581304b5e27e35fd24352640466c28f2a0883.png[/img]

Welcome to our [b]Box to the Beat VR major update[/b] announcement, where we will be talking about multiple changes to the game based on community feedback.

All these changes directly impact how the game will now be played and represent a massive leap that will make our project more accessible to a large number of players from our community. We will be sharing the known issues along with our solutions from a development perspective.

Don't forget to join our Discord community! [url=https://discord.gg/MCkKy6qgmt]Khosouf Studio[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[h3][u]Camera improvements and support for content creators[/u][/h3]
[i]There is no built-in support for camera changes from a spectator's perspective, making the game harder to stream as the view is too narrow.[/i]

🥊 Solution:

- Introducing 5 new spectator modes, built directly into the game for your streaming pleasure.

- [b]Wide Mode[/b]: Provides a centered camera, offering a more immersive viewing experience compared to the previously limited lens perspective.

- [b]Ultra Wide Mode[/b]: Similar to Wide Mode, but with a higher field of view, allowing you to showcase more of the game.

- [b]Third-Person Mode[/b]: Spectate from a dynamic third-person perspective that tracks your movement, capturing exciting shots.

- [b]Drone Mode[/b]: The camera hovers around you in a circular motion, maintaining smooth movement tracking.

- [b]Cinematic Mode[/b]: Experience 8 shot patterns in a cinematic fashion, showcasing various angles and perspectives for an enhanced video presentation.

To make it simple: In all third-person modes, you can see the camera movement in real-time within the game, enabling seamless interaction with your audience.

Enjoy these new spectator modes and take your streaming experience to the next level! We value your feedback as we continue to enhance the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/ef48ee5b6f2cc3206210d08a00227479719d5cb4.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[u][h3]Height correction[/h3][/u]
[i]The targets are too low or too high, and players desire the ability to set the height manually.[/i]

🥊 Solution:

- Introducing a new feature in the settings tab.
- Click the "Set Height" button to calibrate the target height to your current height.
- The targets will now consistently spawn at your desired height, eliminating the automatic height adjustment at the start of each game.
- Players can switch between automatic and manual height settings at any time for flexibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/a84ba24831118d0854309adc2fd0139c4089e602.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/1c0fc2ced514374258a08c6d9850dc769a3a9a26.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h3][u]Gameplay speed[/u][/h3]
[i]Players feel that the targets are either too slow or too fast.[/i]

🥊 Solution:
- Introducing a new feature that allows you to customize the speed of the targets.
- Choose from three options: Slow, Normal, or Fast.
- Tailor the gameplay experience to your preference and skill level.
- As you progress and improve, challenge yourself by increasing the speed for an extra thrill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/ded3067e9ae1a7be2c600af67c6e0ab3e32aebc9.png[/img]

[h3][u]Golden Note clarity[/u][/h3]
[i]The golden note felt ambiguous and did not specify which hand was needed to punch it.[/i]

🥊 Solution
- Introducing the concept of the golden bar.
- Certain sections in the song now feature special double point notes, known as golden bars.
- These notes are clearly marked with an X2 symbol on top, ensuring clear visibility and indicating their punch color.
- Enjoy the enhanced gameplay experience and aim for those valuable double points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/6c55319758c4fe989e9b007639505d0f8a161ad1.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][u]Changes for the best vision[/u][/h3]
[i]The position of punches is too close to the center, causing a vision blockage and preventing players from seeing the next note.[/i]

🥊 Solution:
- After careful analysis of the players' vision grid, we have made adjustments to the location and rotation of all notes.
- Uppercuts are now positioned lower, hooks are placed more to the side, and jabs no longer block each other.
- To further enhance visibility, we have added a small animation to the targets when they spawn.
- These changes ensure that you can see the notes coming even in situations where your vision is filled with punches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/db92e5d654bb0310eb7de3af78e28dae8c140e2f.png[/img]

[h3][u]Graphical options[/u][/h3]
[i]Some players experienced low frames per second, while others felt that their computers could handle more graphical input.[/i]

🥊 Solution:
- Introducing three quality options for you to choose from: Low, High, and Ultra.
- Each option is carefully designed with a curated array of graphical settings.
- Enjoy a smooth and optimized experience regardless of your computer's specifications.
- Find the perfect balance between performance and visual fidelity to suit your rig.

We value your feedback as we strive to provide the best gaming experience possible. Select the quality setting that suits your system, and enjoy your rhythmic adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/2eafe86fdccea12882ed754ce999d65870b7c533.png[/img]

[u][h3]The management of flow and synchronization[/h3][/u]
[i]The beats felt off-sync with the song, and the rhythm lacked flow.[/i]

🥊 Solution:

- We scrapped the old beat system and started from scratch.
- Implemented a more complex system that analyzes the songs and generates precise timing.
- Utilized an industry-standard map editor to manually fill in the timing, ensuring every punch lands exactly on the beat.
- With this approach, we have the ability to edit the maps until they are perfect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/6d808538d82f60d04c0982c4bfde1c669042de9e.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h3][u]Name automation[/u][/h3]
[i]When playing the game on Steam, players have to add their names through the virtual keyboard.[/i]

🥊 Solution:

- After a few changes from the development side, the game will automatically fetch the usernames from Steam players.

Thank you for reading our major update! Stay tuned for more in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

Keep up to date and Wishilist our game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063120/Box_To_The_Beat_VR/

Keep boxing to your beat,
[i]Gabe[/i]

notes.title: Behind the Ring #2 - Development Update
notes.notes:
🥊 Gloves on, Boxers!

Welcome to the second edition of "[b]Behind the Ring[/b]", a series that emphasizes official developer logs, such as upcoming news, plans, and exclusive footage for the game Box to the Beat VR!

Today, it's time to showcase our upcoming DLC, [b]Shadow Dreams[/b], and dive more into the history behind this new and exhilarating creation, where the rhythm transitions to a heavy metal dimension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/a5e612e61c0812e2a58e2b0bde1312aacd4ba250.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[u]The history of Shadow Dreams[/u]

Khosouf Studio's all-time love for music and audio engineering has evolved into a vast, accessible space for one of the world's biggest industries: gaming. From the beautiful landscapes of Abu Dhabi, UAE, where the studio resides, to pushing their rhythm idea internationally. That idea is Box to the Beat VR.

But it doesn't stop there! 

As a studio with a deep love for music, to us, there is simply no better way to kick our first DLC off with something that is extremely close to our hearts; Shadow Dreams' history dates back to 2015, brought to life through an original album created by the CEO/Director of Khosouf, Ahmad. 

Apart from the exhilarating levels everyone will experience upon the game's launch; players will have the opportunity to listen to a range of heavy metal tracks in our upcoming DLC, Shadow Dreams! Check out the ninth song in the Shadow Dreams playlist below:

[i]A nostalgic video from the studio that synergizes with the song "RAGE"[/i]
https://youtu.be/c3fh1fe8a4U

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

[u]Shadow Dreams FAQ[/u]

We compiled much information for a full FAQ structure through the ambitious development phases! 

Joining today is none other than the rhythmic magician himself, Ahmad Al-Natseh:

🥊 [b]Q: What pushed the team into creating Shadow Dreams? Was it just your idea, or did everybody else contribute?[/b]
Ahmad: The creation of Shadow Dreams was initially a one-man band endeavor that inspired the formation of Khosouf Studio. It started as a personal project driven by my passion for music and audio engineering.

🥊 [b]Q: What was the main inspiration for the choice of music in this DLC?[/b]
Ahmad: The main inspiration for the music in Shadow Dreams stemmed from the turbulent times during the war in neighboring Syria in 2012. The album reflects the darkness and instability that resonated from that period.

🥊 [b]Q: What will players expect in terms of intensity for the DLC?[/b]
Ahmad: Players can expect a unique and intense experience. The DLC features heavy metal music with complex rhythms, odd-time signatures, and powerful distorted guitars. Prepare to sweat as the song durations range from 4 to 9.5 minutes.

🥊 [b]Q: Are there any other DLCs planned around the same time as the Shadow Dreams launch?[/b]
Ahmad: Yes, we have a lineup of artists signed up for future DLCs in the game. Shadow Dreams is just the beginning of our support for talented artists who will bring their unique styles to our game.

🥊 [b]Q: What other genres are you thinking of adding as exclusive DLCs?[/b]
Ahmad: Our plan is to explore a wide range of genres in the upcoming DLC patches. From metal to electronic, hip hop to rap, we aim to provide players with diverse and exciting music experiences.

🥊 [b]Q: What artists would you like to work with in the future?[/b]
Ahmad: While it may seem ambitious, our dream collaborations would include iconic bands like Metallica or progressive rock legends Dream Theater. Collaborating with such artists would elevate the complexity and intensity of Box to the Beat VR.

🥊 [b]Q: Share what pushed you into creating Box to the Beat VR and joining the rhythm genre with it.[/b]
Ahmad: Creating purposeful games is the vision behind Khosouf Studio. By combining physical movement that improves players' lifestyles with virtual reality gaming, we aim to fill a significant gap in the market. Box to the Beat VR offers a high-quality product that merges rhythm-based fun with intense physical actions, aiming to enrich players' experiences with your support while supporting upcoming artists by giving them the spotlight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563505/64039f5bb75aa070047d9864be147048a3ab6077.png[/img]

With that being said, this concludes our second edition of [b]Behind the Ring[/b]! Be sure to tune in next time for more development news!
[hr][/hr]
